parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: performs a dry run without removing the multicast member. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
- **false** (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. After the check succeeds, the multicast member is removed.

parameters.name: GroupIpAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the multicast group to which the multicast member belongs.

parameters.name: NetworkInterfaceIds
parameters.description: The list of network interface controller (NIC) IDs.

parameters.name: PeerTransitRouterMulticastDomains
parameters.description: The list of cross-region multicast domain IDs.

parameters.name: TransitRouterMulticastDomainId
parameters.description: The ID of the multicast domain to which the multicast member belongs.
